evidence.mechanism: shot-02s: four nodes (ochre, gold, graphite, rust) at the base trace amber and graphite streams into a central web; by shot-08s the amber stream runs up to the faded rust node at right, so the reversal toward a shaded node is readable.
evidence.ambition: shot-20s: eight nodes in a mirrored radial layout with a rust shadow X and dense hyphae tangled at centre; the Gray-Scott spot pattern from the brief is not visible, only polyline hyphae and sparse dots at shot-02s.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: soft radial glow and shaded spheres on the nodes, cohesive cream, ochre and rust palette; hyphae are wobbly polylines, and shot-20s shows vertical banded vignette stripes on the cream ground.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: amber, rust and graphite sink-flow streams on cream, a mycorrhizal subject none of the anchors use (card weave, Chladni field, birds, reaction-diffusion dish); no slop form visible in any shot.
evidence.polish: shot-08s: framing shifts off-centre with a grey shade band down the right edge; shot-20s resolves into a symmetric four-fold pattern, so 2s is composed and 20s settles.
